role: Applied AI, Forward Deployed Machine Learning Engineer - EMEA
location: EMEA (Paris / London / Luxembourg / Marseille / Amsterdam / Munich / Lausanne)
opening: I am writing to apply for the Applied AI, Forward Deployed Machine Learning Engineer role at Mistral AI. The forward-deployed side of applied AI is where I have spent my working life so far: sitting with the people who have the problem, building the thing that solves it against real constraints, and staying with it once it is in front of users. A European model provider whose customers deploy on their own terms is the environment I would most want to do that in, and I am applying from Venice with the flexibility to be based in any of your EMEA offices.
role_specific: My daily engineering workflow revolves around the exact requirements outlined in your role: I utilize prompt chaining, RAG architectures, and advanced workflow orchestration tools (such as n8n) to connect external APIs with foundational models, working in Python and TypeScript, and I build the backend and frontend interfaces around them rather than stopping at the model call. Agentic systems in production, structured outputs, and the unglamorous work of making them fail safely is what my last three years have consisted of. Two things I should state plainly rather than let you find them: my depth is in applied LLM engineering rather than PyTorch and fine-tuning, and my degree is from Ca' Foscari rather than in computer science. What I bring instead is speed at picking up an unfamiliar stack and a track record of shipping in front of customers.
closing: I would be glad to talk through a customer deployment you are working on and how I would approach the first two weeks of it.
